architecture_checks.requires: PolicyNotActiveException class with policy_number, incident_date, policy_effective_date, policy_expiry_date, reason_code fields
architecture_checks.trace: AC2, AC3, AC5: Error responses must include all dates and policy number

architecture_checks.requires: PolicyReasonCode enum with POLICY_EXPIRED and POLICY_NOT_EFFECTIVE values
architecture_checks.trace: AC2, AC3: Reason codes in error responses

architecture_checks.requires: PolicyService class with validate_policy_active(policy: Policy, incident_date: datetime) -> bool method
architecture_checks.trace: AC1, AC2, AC3, AC4, AC5: Core validation logic

architecture_checks.requires: Policy model with effective_date and expiry_date fields (both datetime, nullable expiry_date)
architecture_checks.trace: AC1, AC4: Policy date fields required

architecture_checks.requires: DocumentChecklistLoader class with load_checklists() method that returns dict[LineOfBusiness, List[DocumentType]]
architecture_checks.trace: AC1, AC2, AC3: Checklist loading and caching

architecture_checks.requires: JSON file with Motor checklist [POLICE_FIR, REPAIR_INVOICE], Health checklist [HOSPITAL_BILL, DISCHARGE_SUMMARY], Life checklist [DEATH_CERTIFICATE]
DocumentType enum with POLICE_FIR, REPAIR_INVOICE, HOSPITAL_BILL, DISCHARGE_SUMMARY, DEATH_CERTIFICATE values
DocumentChecklist model with lob, document_type, required boolean, description, version, effective_date fields
architecture_checks.trace: AC4, AC5: Checklist metadata and versioning

architecture_checks.requires: FraudRulesLoader class with load_rules() method returning dict[LineOfBusiness, FraudRuleSet]
architecture_checks.trace: AC1, AC2, AC3: Fraud rule loading and caching

architecture_checks.requires: JSON file with fraud rules per LOB (Motor, Health, Life) including rule_name, operator, threshold, weight, description
architecture_checks.trace: AC1: Rule definitions with all required fields

architecture_checks.requires: FraudRuleVersion model with version_number, effective_date, created_by_admin_id, is_active, lob, rules_json fields
architecture_checks.trace: AC4, AC6: Versioning with immutable history

architecture_checks.requires: ConfigurationError exception for malformed fraud rule configuration
architecture_checks.trace: AC5: Error handling for invalid config

architecture_checks.requires: AssessmentService class with evaluate_coverage(policy: Policy, claim: Claim) -> CoverageAssessment method
architecture_checks.trace: AC1, AC2, AC3, AC5, AC6: Coverage assessment logic

architecture_checks.requires: CoverageReasonCode enum with FULL_COVERAGE, PARTIAL_COVERAGE, NOT_COVERED, CLAIM_TYPE_NOT_COVERED, INCIDENT_OUTSIDE_COVERAGE, POLICY_EXCLUSION values
CoverageAssessment dataclass/model with is_covered boolean, coverage_reason_code, details fields

scenarios.name: test_policy_active_within_date_range
scenarios.description: Policy with effective_date and expiry_date returns True when incident_date is between them

scenarios.name: test_policy_active_exact_effective_date
scenarios.description: Policy returns True when incident_date equals effective_date

scenarios.name: test_policy_active_exact_expiry_date
scenarios.description: Policy returns True when incident_date equals expiry_date

scenarios.name: test_policy_expired
scenarios.description: Policy with expiry_date in past raises PolicyNotActiveException with POLICY_EXPIRED reason

scenarios.name: test_policy_not_effective
scenarios.description: Policy with future effective_date raises PolicyNotActiveException with POLICY_NOT_EFFECTIVE reason

scenarios.name: test_policy_null_expiry_indefinite
scenarios.description: Policy with NULL expiry_date is active if effective_date <= incident_date

scenarios.name: test_policy_null_expiry_before_effective
scenarios.description: Policy with NULL expiry_date is inactive if incident_date before effective_date

scenarios.name: test_validation_error_includes_all_fields
scenarios.description: PolicyNotActiveException includes policy_number, incident_date, effective_date, expiry_date, reason_code

scenarios.name: test_motor_checklist_loaded
scenarios.description: Motor checklist includes POLICE_FIR and REPAIR_INVOICE

scenarios.name: test_health_checklist_loaded
scenarios.description: Health checklist includes HOSPITAL_BILL and DISCHARGE_SUMMARY

scenarios.name: test_life_checklist_loaded
scenarios.description: Life checklist includes DEATH_CERTIFICATE

scenarios.name: test_checklists_cached_at_startup
scenarios.description: Checklists are loaded from config file and cached in memory

scenarios.name: test_missing_document_identified
scenarios.description: Motor claim with only POLICE_FIR identifies REPAIR_INVOICE as missing

scenarios.name: test_checklist_metadata_present
scenarios.description: Checklist entries include document_type, required boolean, description

scenarios.name: test_checklist_versioning
scenarios.description: Checklist configuration includes version and effective_date

scenarios.name: test_fraud_rules_loaded_from_config
scenarios.description: Fraud rules loaded at startup for Motor, Health, Life

scenarios.name: test_fraud_thresholds_per_lob
scenarios.description: Each LOB has defined fraud score threshold

scenarios.name: test_rule_fields_present
scenarios.description: Rule includes name, operator, threshold, weight, description

scenarios.name: test_versioning_fields_present
scenarios.description: Rules include version_number, effective_date, created_by_admin_id

scenarios.name: test_invalid_config_raises_error
scenarios.description: Malformed or missing fraud rule config raises ConfigurationError with details
assertions: assert 'parsing' in str(exc) or 'missing' in str(exc)

scenarios.name: test_rules_cached_in_memory
scenarios.description: Fraud rules are immutable at runtime (cached after loading)

scenarios.name: test_version_history_preserved
scenarios.description: Configuration updates create new versions without deleting old versions

scenarios.name: test_coverage_accepts_inputs
scenarios.description: AssessmentService.evaluate_coverage accepts policy and claim objects

scenarios.name: test_coverage_claim_type_included
scenarios.description: Motor policy with MOTOR coverage returns is_covered=True

scenarios.name: test_coverage_claim_type_excluded
scenarios.description: Motor policy without HEALTH returns is_covered=False with CLAIM_TYPE_NOT_COVERED

scenarios.name: test_coverage_policy_exclusion
scenarios.description: Policy with pre-existing exclusion returns is_covered=False with POLICY_EXCLUSION

scenarios.name: test_coverage_incident_outside_period
scenarios.description: Claim with incident_date outside policy term returns is_covered=False with INCIDENT_OUTSIDE_COVERAGE

scenarios.name: test_coverage_response_includes_both_fields
scenarios.description: Coverage assessment returns is_covered boolean and reason_code

scenarios.name: test_coverage_deterministic
scenarios.description: Same policy and claim always produces same coverage decision

scenarios.name: test_coverage_with_versioned_policy
scenarios.description: Assessment uses pinned policy version from claim

scenarios.name: test_partial_coverage
scenarios.description: Policy with partial coverage (e.g., co-insurance) returns PARTIAL_COVERAGE
